en.title: Vibe Checks Aren't Evals: Testing an LLM Feature Before You Ship It
en.subtitle: A few good-looking outputs prove little. Real cases, a clear bar, automated grading and repeated runs tell you if it's ready.

ar-EG.title: تجربة كام prompt مش تقييم: إزاي تختبر feature معمولة بالـ LLM قبل ما تنزّلها
ar-EG.subtitle: كام output شكلهم حلو مابيثبتوش حاجة. اللي بيقولك إنها جاهزة: حالات حقيقية، ومعيار واضح، وتصحيح أوتوماتيك، وتشغيل أكتر من مرة.

import sys
import types

NS = types.SimpleNamespace
ROUTER_PROMPT = "Route the ticket. Reply with one word: billing, technical or account."
_QUEUES = {"charged": "billing", "refund": "billing", "crash": "technical",
           "login": "technical", "email": "account", "password": "account"}


def _create(*, model, max_tokens, messages, system="", **kwargs):
    text = messages[-1]["content"].lower()
    queue = next((q for k, q in _QUEUES.items() if k in text), "technical")
    return NS(content=[NS(type="text", text=queue.capitalize())],
              stop_reason="end_turn")


def route(ticket):
    reply = _create(model="", max_tokens=1, messages=[{"content": ticket}])
    return reply.content[0].text


def load_cases(path):
    return [{"text": "I was charged twice for March", "queue": "billing"},
            {"text": "refund pls, wrong plan", "queue": "billing"},
            {"text": "App crashes when I open reports", "queue": "technical"},
            {"text": "cant login since update", "queue": "technical"},
            {"text": "How do I change my email?", "queue": "account"},
            {"text": "Reset password link expired", "queue": "account"}]


sys.modules["anthropic"] = NS(Anthropic=lambda **kw: NS(messages=NS(create=_create)))
